task: JVM class-file toolkit: strict reader/writer, disassembler and stack-depth analyzer verified against javap, reflection and the JDK corpus
reasoning_summary: Designed a strict class-file reader/writer with a javap-style disassembler and a slot-based stack analyzer, writing tests first with crafted images (each defect paired with a control) and JDK oracles (javap, reflection, writeUTF, whole java.util/java.lang round trip). First runs exposed an ldc2_w effect shadowed by a fixed-effect table, handler entry depth missing from max stack, and my own miscounted fixtures; a 24-mutant pass found 4 test gaps, all closed.
